I am a joint Computer Science & Statistics Honours student with a passion for building at the intersection of software development and statistical theory. I enjoy translating complex theory into clean, interpretable, and optimized algorithmic implementations. 

Currently, I am serving as an NSERC USRA Research Intern under the supervision of Dr. Alexandre Leblanc. My work explores nonparametric and computational statistics, with a specific focus on bivariate and multivariate data depth functions.

This blog serves as a public research log, a space to document and share my code optimizations, literature reviews, and research challenges. Whether you are a fellow student, a researcher, or just curious about computer science, statistics, or both, I invite you to explore the logs. If you would like to discuss my work, share feedback, or just chat about tech and stats, feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn!
